components.css: .brick-wallet-list{min-height:220px;display:grid;gap:14px;padding:18px;border:1px solid #dbe3ef;border-radius:8px;background:#fff;color:#172033;font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif}.brick-wallet-list *{box-sizing:border-box}.brick-wallet-list header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}.brick-wallet-list header span{color:#64748b;font-size:12px;font-weight:850}.brick-wallet-list header strong{color:#111827;font-size:22px;font-weight:950}.brick-wallet-list .wallets{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}.brick-wallet-list article{display:grid;gap:12px;padding:14px;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:8px;background:#f8fbff}.brick-wallet-list article span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;min-width:0}.brick-wallet-list article i{width:30px;height:30px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border:1px solid #dbe3ef;border-radius:999px;background:#fff;color:#172033;font-size:15px;font-style:normal;font-weight:950}.brick-wallet-list article b{color:#172033;font-size:15px;font-weight:950}.brick-wallet-list article strong{color:#111827;font-size:24px;font-weight:950;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;letter-spacing:0}@media(max-width:720px){.brick-wallet-list .wallets{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
